in_sanskrit.name: Manjappa
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Gem of Mantra
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Manjappa एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Manjappa is a combination of two Sanskrit words - Mantra and Jappa. Mantra means a powerful chant or prayer, while Jappa means to repeat. Thus, Manjappa means one who chants powerful mantras. The name is derived from the Tamil word Manjam, which means gem. Therefore, Manjappa can also be interpreted as the one who holds the gem of mantras or the one who chants powerful mantras like a gem.
